hosp-1.name: City Care Hospital
hosp-1.description: City Care Hospital is a premier multi-specialty institution known for excellence in emergency medicine and cardiology. Featuring advanced critical care monitoring, responsive ICU chambers, and highly trained physicians available around the clock.

hosp-2.name: Sunrise Hospital
hosp-2.description: Sunrise Hospital offers top-tier pediatric and general surgery services with specialized emergency care teams. While currently experiencing a high patient load in the ICU department, our comprehensive outpatient clinic and urgent care units remain fully operational.

hosp-3.name: Hope Multi-Speciality
hosp-3.description: Hope Multi-Speciality Hospital excels in neurology and orthopedics diagnostics. Features modern private suites, a state-of-the-art diagnostic imaging center, and an automated pharmacy hub connected directly to regional paramedics.

hosp-4.name: Life Care Hospital
hosp-4.location: Sector 15, Green Park Avenue, Metro City
hosp-4.description: Life Care Hospital provides general internal medicine services, wellness testing, and critical trauma management. Known for short wait times in emergency registration and top rating in patient safety certifications.
